Build on open-source WordPress

Unlock limitless potential with the open-source ecommerce platform built on WordPress. Unparalleled customization empowers you to create tailored online stores that meet any client’s unique needs.

Need to integrate with other software? If there’s not already an extension in our Marketplace, you can build your own connections with nearly any application out there.

Design exactly the store you need

Take complete creative control of WooCommerce storefronts and craft unique, brand-reflecting experiences instead of cookie-cutter websites. Use the intuitive block editor to design modern, engaging stores that are easy to update and manage.

Extend your revenue streams

Have an idea for an extension that will benefit WooCommerce merchants? Add recurring revenue streams to your business by selling your work in our Marketplace. Tens of thousands of merchants and developers visit every month to find solutions for automation, shipping, marketing, and more.

Fast, flexible, and extensible

WooCommerce offers the flexibility and control needed to bring any e-commerce vision to life.

Full customization

WooCommerce is open source, giving you full control to personalize every aspect of a storefront. Integrate any tools, add functionality with hundreds of extensions, or extend for completely new solutions.

Advanced performance

Build on a robust foundation that scales effortlessly. WooCommerce ensures your clients’ sites handle increasing traffic and complexity without limitations.

Modern deployment

Deploy with confidence using version control. Easily track changes, revert if needed, and maintain the flexibility and security to manage projects efficiently.

Data ownership

Unlike closed platforms, WooCommerce gives your clients complete ownership of their store and data. Their information is truly theirs, and you choose your preferred hosting solution.
